title: MAP: document risk-tiered review convention (from ClearFront audit)
description: Reusable MAP-level half of the ClearFront process-improvement batch (operator-directed, hcom thread clearfront-map #1851, following the independent audit at Projects/ClearFront/artifacts/reviews/clearfront-independent-delivery-audit-2026-07-17.md). Add a Risk-Tiered Review section to MAP_System/notes/review-guide.md: three lanes (high/medium/low) with concrete criteria for what each requires, so any MAP project -- not just ClearFront -- can calibrate review/release ceremony to actual risk instead of applying the full pipeline uniformly. References Projects/ClearFront/shared/decisions.md DEC-CF-008 as the worked example and origin. Low-risk documentation change per the very convention it introduces -- self-verified, one light cross-read from lilo, no independent-reproduction review cycle.
acceptance_criteria: review-guide.md gains a Risk-Tiered Review section defining high/medium/low lanes with concrete process requirements per lane.
The new section cross-references DEC-CF-008 as the worked example and the audit as the source finding.
No change to existing sections (Claim Before Reviewing, Debate) -- purely additive.
